Villa Sumalee

Townhouse in Rawai
HomeSaleVilla Sumalee

Project render from a public listing page for Villa Sumalee. Layouts and finishes may differ from the final product.

Project overview

Villa Sumalee is a small completed complex of two-storey townhouses in Rawai, southern Phuket, built in 2017. The roughly 144 sqm homes have two bedrooms and three bathrooms and share a communal pool.

Villa Sumalee: key facts

  • Villa Sumalee is a 2-storey townhouse with communal pool in Rawai, Phuket.
  • Units: 2 bedrooms, 144 sqm.
  • Construction status: completed; completion listed as Dec 2017.
  • Advertised starting price: ฿8,950,000.
  • Nearest beach: Rawai Beach (6.1 km).
  • Nearby, according to the project data: Rawai Beach (6.1 km); Chalong Hospital (2.0 km, straight line); Dibuk Hospital (7.7 km, straight line); Makro (1.1 km, straight line).

Facilities & amenities

  • Communal swimming pool
  • 24-hour security
  • CCTV
  • Car park
